entry_gate: complete discovery rg, pair-level novelty audit, and replication prioritization; no local result may be inspected before the pair family and input checksums are locked

pair_strata.PRIORITY_DISCOVERY: Tier A or B apparently novel/no-direct-rg pair with dense full-resolution statistics
pair_strata.GLOBAL_NULL_SECONDARY: globally non-significant pair selected before local result access using documented biological relevance or polygenic-overlap evidence

global_null_definition: extension_fdr>=0.05 in the complete isolated extension family with clean global rg status and both traits passing h2 QC
global_null_curation_rule: manual SELECTED_GLOBAL_NULL_SECONDARY status requires HIGH/MODERATE biological relevance or a non-placeholder polygenic-overlap rationale; global rg magnitude alone is insufficient

local_testing.univariate_gate: for LAVA_PRIMARY use run.univ.bivar with a pre-result Bonferroni threshold 0.05 divided by twice the locked pair-by-locus family size; retain and report local h2, SE, and P for both traits at every locked locus and preserve loci that cannot enter bivariate testing
local_testing.primary_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg over all clean, estimable LAVA_PRIMARY bivariate local-rg P values in the exact locked pair-by-locus family
local_testing.reproducibility: freeze a deterministic nonzero LAVA simulation seed for every selected pair before result access
local_testing.robustness_policy: HDL-L is sensitivity evidence and is not mixed into the LAVA primary FDR family; same-locus directional support requires clean convergence/QC and nominal two-sided P<0.05
local_testing.strong_local_support: at least two FDR-significant LAVA loci, or at least one FDR-significant LAVA locus with directionally concordant clean HDL-L evidence at the same locus

claim_limit: global or local genetic correlation is not evidence of a shared causal variant or causality
